docs.text: Overview 404 Brid is a Brid created by @crLms1n that was added on January 21, 2026. Obtainment In the Glitch realm (see entrance on its page), in the farthest corner from spawn, 404 Brid sits on a wall. You will have to jump pretty high for this Brid. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' On a wall in the outskirts. ' and its description reads ' Error: File not found. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the eighteenth Brid. This Brid was the second of the two Brids added to the Glitch subarea before it was changed to a realm. This Brid used to be the hardest Brid in the game before Fatal Error was created to take its place.

docs.text: Overview 8-Brid is a Brid created by @kajussls121 that was added on January 25, 2026. Obtainment In the Glitch realm (see entrance on its page), in the temple structure, there is a set of numbers on a panel that reads ' 47 101 32 112 105 120 101 108 97 116 49 48 110 '. Decoding this ASCII text gives the code ' /e pixelat10n '. Entering this code spawns the Brid on one of the temple's back pillars. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' In the temple ruins. ' and its description reads ' A stray set of pixels from an old game. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the twenty-second Brid.

docs.text: Brids Brids are the main collectible in the game. As of this writing, there are 170 Brids in the game, ranging from trivially easy to unimaginably difficult. All Brids in the game are given a special name and design that is unique to them only. Statistics Main Stats Each Brid is given five main statistics, those being Area, Description, Difficulty, Hint, and Series. Area: The location in which a Brid is in. The area is not actually decided by where the Brid is at, but where the Brid starts, which in many cases overlap. However, in the case of Brids in sub-areas, this is necessary. Some Brids are in subrealms, in which case the Area is the name of the subrealm they are in. Description: The description of the Brid. This is sometimes picked by the creator of the Brid, but in many cases the Brids are given descriptions to fit the Find the Brids lore. Difficulty: The indication of how hard the Brid is to obtain. In order, the difficulties are Freebie, Easy, Medium, Hard, Challenging, Worrying, Extreme, Inhuman, Supreme, Impossible, Transcendant. The difficulties in the extreme-inhuman range are classified as 'mind-numbing', with them taking at least a decent amount of skill to obtain. Any Brid in the Transcendant difficulty is classified as 'brain-shattering' due to them needing extremely immense skill in puzzle solving/obbying. Hint: A bit of information to help steer Brid hunters in the right direction when looking for the Brid. Series: A set of Brids with a common idea are sometimes grouped into a Series. The only two series that exist as of writing this are Troll and Secret. Substatistics There are also four more statistics that are less important than the main ones, those being Badge ID, Credit, Is In Subrealm, and Required. Badge ID: The ID of the badge that is to be awarded when a player obtains the specified Brid. Credit: This is used internally to display who created the Brid in the Index. Is In Subrealm: This is also used internally to display an area correctly is a Brid is in a subrealm. Required: If the Brid is required, you must obtain it to complete the game. If not, the Brid is moved to a separate page within the Index and it is no longer required to complete the game. Trivia Brids are based off of a poorly drawn bird that the creator of the game drew on his homeroom teacher's whiteboard in his freshman year of high school. Realms Realms are alternate dimensions used to store Brids that don't fit the main theme of any specific area. Main Realm The realm you spawn in when you join the game, stores all the main Brids. Glitch A digital realm to store digital Brids. Backrooms The popular creepypasta turned into a Brid realm. Delta's Void Used to store Delta Secret Brid after doing its puzzle. test_findTheDogs Used for the first part of Sociebrid's puzzle. Fishing Simulator Used for all things related to the Size 2 Brid.

docs.text: Overview Bridtain is a Brid created by @kajussls121 that was added on January 19, 2026. Obtainment Climb up the flagpole in Grassland, the Brid should be on the right side if you're facing it from spawn. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' On the flag. ' and its description reads '*I LOVE BRITIAN YAY' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the fifteenth Brid. This Brid used to have a different name, that being United Briddom. This was changed when the creator of the game realized that Bridtain was a much better play on words than United Briddom.

docs.text: Overview Choco Brid is a Brid created by @LazerAmplified that was added on January 25, 2026. Obtainment On the flagpole on the opposite side of Bridtain, under the far side of the path, there is Base 64-encoded text that reads ' L2UgQW50SGlsbDExOTQxOQ== '. Decoding this gives you the code ' /e AntHill119419 '. Enter this code takes you the Choco Brid's subarea, where you have to do a small amount of obbying to reach the Brid. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' The flag. ' and its description reads ' Made from chocolate, or is it from the ant hill substance? ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the twenty-third Brid. Troll Brid's subarea copies this Brid's subarea.

docs.text: Overview Glitch Brid is a Brid created by @LazerAmplified that was added on January 20, 2026. Obtainment In the Glitch realm (see entrance on its page), go on top of the map, enable sprint and jump onto the floating RGB-colored bundle closest to spawn. It should be on the far side of the blue-colored part. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' Up in the sky. ' and its description reads '*L̸̨̡̥̥̽̆͑̆o̷͉̻͇̬̿̔̚r̴̢̥̗͓̆̏ĕ̵̡̞̦̤m̶̠̳̩̽͝ ̵͖̙͇͇̓̍͂i̸̫̜̱̔p̵̰͎͙̹̒͠s̶̟̊ú̴̡̙͎m̸̡͕̭͆̏̏' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the seventeenth Brid. This Brid is the first Brid to be added to a subrealm. This, however, was not always the case. When the Glitch realm was only a subarea, Glitch Brid was one of the two Brids added before it was changed to a realm.

( For the obtainment of Omnimagical Brid, see its page. ) Next to the platform there is a truss. Climb to the top and the Brid is there. Trivia This Brid's hint reads " Somewhere magical... docs.text: Overview Lottery Brid is a Brid created by @LazerAmplified that was added on January 19, 2026. Obtainment On a tree in the ice area, there is a code: ' /e lottery '. Entering this code will bring you to this Brid's subarea, where you then have to type '/e' and then a random number from 1 to 292,201,338 with commas. The correct number to type is ' /e 51,904,396 '. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' GAMBLING 🤑🤑 ' and its description reads '*I... My condolences.' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the thirteenth Brid. Before precise difficulty ratings were removed, this Brid had a difficulty of Impossible (777.77). This Brid is not required to be collected to complete the game. It is the first Brid to do so.

docs.text: Overview Omnimagical Brid is a Brid created by @Evanprice141 that was added on May 30, 2026. (Its original version was added January 18, 2026.) Obtainment On the candy-cane looking structure in the Void area, there is an eight-letter code. This code is a Pastebin link , which when visited reads " RHOLW]KPHKZPHLMXSZMX]IXHNJXKXIYT'4'T 'jpwoly.z'uhtl'pz'why{s 'hzzvjph{lk'~p{o'wsh nyv|uk'lx|pwtlu{5'^oh{'ht'PF'4'VTUP Good luck. ' This is an ASCII Shift Cipher shifted -7. Shifting it up to +7 reads ' KAHEPVDIADSIAEFQLSFQVBQAGCQDQBRM - My cipher's name is partly associated with playground equipment. What am I? - OMNI '. This is a Slidefair cipher, with the code being at the end (OMNI). Deciphering the ciphertext with the key gives you the text ' MYSTICALPOWERNINEZEROISYOURCODE '. Typing in ' /e mysticalpower90 ' in the code inputter will teleport you to the brid's subarea, where the Brid is just in front of you. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' Supporting a candy cane-like structure.. ' and its description reads ' Complete control over all things magical. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the third Brid. This Brid is the first Brid added to be considered 'mind-numbing', being the bare minimum difficulty for it, Extreme. This Brid had an original version. You can view it Its original version also had the first part of its puzzle hidden in the console and not on the structure. This Brid has always been linked to Helpless Brid since Helpless Brid was added, where Helpless Brid's subarea was a branch off of Omnimagical Brid's subarea in some way.

docs.text: Overview Secret Brid is a Brid created by @crLms1n that was added on January 19, 2026. Obtainment In the Grassland house, there is a table holding a computer. This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the twelfth Brid. This Brid's subarea contains a button for Delta Secret Brid. This Brid is part of the Secret series, and was the first Brid to get a series.
